nodes.question: Does the edited image establish that the source paper is stuffed inside the source cup?
nodes.criteria: Inspect the edited endpoint directly and compare candidate objects with the source using shape, material, opening geometry, relative scale, and scene context as well as color. Pass only when sufficient correspondence evidence identifies the requested objects and the paper visibly occupies the cup interior in a stuffed placement, rather than lying nearby or on its rim. Fail when visible evidence rules out that endpoint: either the matched objects clearly show an unstuffed placement, or every plausible correspondence supported by the images clearly lacks the required interior placement. Appearance differences alone do not establish failure. Unknown when correspondence, occlusion, or placement leaves completion genuinely possible but unestablished. Describe correspondence evidence separately from interior-placement evidence; do not assess progress here.
nodes.binding: The paper and cup remain anchored to the source-image objects. Appearance changes may be compatible with correspondence but do not prove it. Do not substitute unrelated objects or require exact color, printing, or shape preservation.

nodes.question: Do the source and edited images establish actual progress toward stuffing the source paper into the source cup while also establishing that stuffing is not complete?
nodes.criteria: Independently compare source and edited placement and object correspondence; s1 is advisory, not a prerequisite. Pass only when sufficient correspondence and placement evidence establishes an actual advance toward insertion and also rules out completed stuffing. Relevant evidence can include demonstrable movement into the opening or incomplete insertion compared with the source. Mere proximity, a hand holding paper, or a plausible object match alone is insufficient. Fail only when the images establish that no requested change has progressed, which also excludes completion; do not use fail merely because incomplete progress was not proven. Unknown when correspondence, the change in placement, or the distinction between incomplete and completed insertion remains unresolved. Report the visual basis for correspondence and the comparative placement separately.
nodes.binding: Only progress involving the source paper and source cup counts. Assess correspondence through visible shape, material, opening geometry, scale, and context while allowing appearance changes. Do not infer either progress or its absence from color differences, uncertain identity, or unrelated edits.

nodes.question: Paper is stuffed into the cup.
nodes.criteria: Return complete (yes) when s1 passes. Otherwise return partial when s2 passes, because its proposition independently establishes requested progress short of completion; return absent (no) when s2 fails, because its proposition independently establishes no requested progress, including no completion. These s2 alternatives apply even if s1 is unknown. Return unknown when neither alternative is established or valid evidence conflicts. If s2 is skipped because s1 passes, completion is established without s2. Any other skipped or unknown support supplies no negative evidence. Unrelated edits and correspondence alone earn no progress credit.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
